subject: english
title: The Red Kite
objective: Identify visible people, places, objects, and actions in a picture.
introduction: Milo sees a red kite in the sky! Name only what you can see in the picture, then tell it in a full sentence.

vocabulary.definition: A red kite is a toy that flies in the sky.
A basket is a container that sits on the table.
The children are the kids standing beside a tree.

items.explanation: A picture shows details you can see, so name those first.
A red kite is an object your eyes can see; a wish, a sound, and a perfume cannot be seen.
Picture clues give real things to name, so they support what you describe.

items.prompt: Which one can you see in the picture?
items.explanation: A basket on the table is visible in the picture; you cannot see a dream, a smell, or a secret thought.
